audit_status.source_base: Greek Gospel text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for transfiguration, Moses/Elijah, beloved Son voice, Elijah/John interpretation, difficult healing scene, little trust, second passion prediction, temple tax, and fish coin sign.

verses.restored: After six days Jesus takes Peter, James, and John his brother and brings them up into a high mountain by themselves.

familiar.text: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,

verses.restored: He was transfigured before them; his face shone like the sun, and his garments became white as light.

familiar.text: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.

verses.restored: And look, Moses and Elijah appeared to them, speaking with him.

familiar.text: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.

verses.restored: Peter answered and said to Jesus, Lord, it is beautiful/good for us to be here; if you wish, I will make here three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

familiar.text: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

verses.restored: While he was still speaking, look, a bright cloud overshadowed them, and look, a voice from the cloud said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I delight; listen to him.

familiar.text: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.

verses.restored: When the disciples heard, they fell on their faces and were greatly afraid.

familiar.text: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.

verses.restored: Jesus came, touched them, and said, Rise, and do not fear.

familiar.text: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.

verses.restored: Lifting their eyes, they saw no one except Jesus himself alone.

familiar.text: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.

verses.restored: As they came down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, Tell the vision to no one until the Son of Humanity is raised from the dead.

familiar.text: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.

verses.restored: The disciples asked him, Why then do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?

familiar.text: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?

verses.restored: He answered, Elijah indeed comes and will restore all things.

familiar.text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.

verses.restored: But I say to you that Elijah already came, and they did not recognize him, but did to him whatever they wished. So also the Son of Humanity is about to suffer by them.

familiar.text: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.

verses.restored: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them about John the Baptist.

familiar.text: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.

verses.restored: When they came to the crowd, a man came to him, kneeling before him and saying,

familiar.text: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,

verses.restored: Lord, have mercy on my son, because he is afflicted and suffers badly; for often he falls into fire and often into water.

familiar.text: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.

verses.restored: I brought him to your disciples, and they were not able to heal him.

familiar.text: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.

verses.restored: Jesus answered, O untrusting and distorted generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him here to me.

familiar.text: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.

verses.restored: Jesus rebuked it, and the troubling force came out from him; and the child was healed from that hour.

familiar.text: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.

verses.restored: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately and said, Why were we not able to cast it out?

familiar.text: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?

verses.restored: He said to them, Because of your little trust. Amen, I say to you: if you have trust like a mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, Move from here to there, and it will move; nothing will be impossible for you.

familiar.text: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

verses.restored: [Some later manuscripts add: But this kind does not go out except by prayer and fasting.]

familiar.text: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.

verses.restored: As they gathered in Galilee, Jesus said to them, The Son of Humanity is about to be handed over into human hands,

familiar.text: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:

verses.restored: and they will kill him, and on the third day he will be raised. And they were deeply grieved.

familiar.text: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.

verses.restored: When they came to Capernaum, those collecting the two-drachma tax came to Peter and said, Does your teacher not pay the two-drachma tax?

familiar.text: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?

verses.restored: He said, Yes. When he came into the house, Jesus spoke first to him, saying, What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth take toll or tax: from their sons or from others?

familiar.text: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?

verses.restored: When he said, From others, Jesus said to him, Then the sons are free.

familiar.text: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.

verses.restored: But so that we do not cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take the first fish that comes up. Opening its mouth, you will find a stater; take that and give it to them for me and you.

familiar.text: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.
